newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire rebels say can only go to talks on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels say can only go to talks on Sunday.

text.p: Zairean rebels said on Thursday rebel leader Laurent Kabila could only attend face-to-face talks with President Mobutu Sese Seko on Sunday.
"We are unable to go to the talks on Saturday. President Kabila can only attend on Sunday. That is the time we have for the talks," rebel "foreign minister" Bizima Karaha told Reuters.
South African President Nelson Mandela said through a spokesman earlier on Thursday he would chair the face-to-face talks between Mobutu and Kabila on board a South African ship on Friday.

Earlier on Thursday, Mobutu's camp said they had understood the meeting was being postponed for a day until Saturday. U.S. envoy Mark Richardson, announcing both sides' agreement to meet, said on Wednesday the encounter would take place on Friday.
